sources: MN DNR park data spk00142 (maps.dnr.state.mn.us/cgi-bin/compass/feature_detail.cgi?id=spk00142): overnight facilities, seasonal update, alert, contact

ReserveMN (mnrdr.usedirect.com) search/grid and search/details for facilities 989 (Lakeview Campground) and 824 (Maple Grove Campground), 2027-06-15, plus season grids Oct 2026 and Apr 2027, read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: DNR seasonal update ('The park has a total of 51 electric sites between two campgrounds. There are 20/30/50 outlets at each electrical site.'; 'The park does not have sites with water and sewer hookups.') + ReserveMN unit details ('Amp': '50' on electric sites), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Lakeview Campground about 63 sites (61 bookable online, mostly electric, nearer the lake; the shore row 1-7 suits small campers, pads 33-46 ft), Maple Grove 40 wooded sites (9 electric, pads 40-64 ft). Plus six walk-to group sites.

sites.source: DNR overnight facilities ('two campgrounds totaling 103 wooded drive-in sites'; 'The max RV length is 60 feet. Length is measured from the front of the tow vehicle to the rear of the vehicle being towed.'; group camp '75' to 450' from parking') + ReserveMN grids (989: Drive-In #1 to Electric #62E; 824: Drive-In #63 to #103, 9 electric; VehicleLength 33-58 ft and 40-64 ft; 'Lakeview Shore site. Best for medium size tent or small camper.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: A shower building in the centre of each campground, open seasonally; water on from the first week of May.

facilities.source: DNR overnight facilities ('The campgrounds have accessible shower buildings open seasonally.'; 'accessible restroom buildings open seasonally'; 'Vault toilets are available year-round throughout the park.'; 'The dump station is open seasonally.') + seasonal update ('reservations for both the Lakeview and Maple Grove Campgrounds include access to a shower building located in the center of each campground'; 'Water will be turned on again in the spring, in the first week of May, 2027.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 2027: Lakeview opens April 16, Maple Grove April 23; water, showers and the dump station from the first week of May. 2026 camping ended October 17.

season.source: DNR seasonal update ('In spring of 2027, Lakeview Campground will open on April 16th. The Maple Grove Campground will open on April 23rd, 2027'; 'The Campground shower houses closed on October 18th, 2026'; 'The dump station closed on October 18th, 2026') + ReserveMN 989 and 824 grids (in season through 2026-10-17, out from 2026-10-18; 989 in season from 2027-04-16), read 2026-11-11

fees.source: ReserveMN search/details for facility 989 and 824 units, night of 2027-06-15: non-electric drive-in 'Rate 24.00', electric 'Rate 34.00', read 2026-11-11

note: Lakeview and Maple Grove campgrounds on the southeast shore of Mille Lacs Lake near Isle. Lakeview's shore row and a few electric sites look out on the lake through the wooded bank; Maple Grove sits back in maple woods. Campers' boat docks in Lakeview; swimming beach, fishing piers, boat access and a fish-cleaning house. --Claude
summary: DNR + ReserveMN: 103 drive-in sites (Lakeview ~63, Maple Grove 40; ReserveMN lists 61 + 40), 51 electric 20/30/50 A, no water/sewer hookups, max RV 60 ft (stored 64 -> 60), showers/flush/vault/dump; 2027 opens Apr 16 (Lakeview) / Apr 23 (Maple Grove), 2026 ended Oct 17; $24 / $34 electric re-read. Lakeview kept on the shore row 1-7 and 14E. Campgrounds closed for the season (ordinary).
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview kept (checked hard). ReserveMN names Lakeview sites 1-7 'Lakeview Shore site' (e.g. #4 at 46.14875,-93.48638, #7 at 46.14892,-93.48701) and 14E 'Has a view of the lake'. On leaf-off imagery those pads are about 33-47 m from the Mille Lacs shoreline, but through a wooded bank (ReserveMN: 'Shaded: Partially'), so not lakefront over open ground; a filtered view holds. ReserveMN gives every Lakeview site '.1 mile' and Maple Grove '.2 mile' to the lake (coarse).
max_rig_ft: stored 64 (note prose) -> 60, the DNR's posted 'max RV length is 60 feet' (front of tow vehicle to rear of towed). The longest ReserveMN pad is 64 ft (Maple Grove).

Electric count: DNR says 51 electric sites; ReserveMN grids list 40 'E' sites in Lakeview plus 9 electric in Maple Grove (49); the stored note's '41 electric' is out of date either way. Count not a structured field.

Status: DNR alert 'Campgrounds are now closed for the fall/winter season. Campgrounds will re-open in the spring, starting in late April, 2027.' Ordinary seasonal close; vehicle gate locked from November 15.

Pin 46.1490,-93.4905 sits on the wooded shore north of Maple Grove: ~150 m from the Maple Grove centroid (46.14766,-93.49064) and ~270 m from Lakeview's (46.14805,-93.48708). Between the two campgrounds; OK as a two-campground pin, or move to 46.1479,-93.4888 (between the loops) if preferred.
